METHOD NOTE: pdftotext (both plain and -layout) extracted only the marketing/policy text on both pages — the entire rate table (both the room-rate grid and the room-inventory/bedding-options grid) is embedded as a large JPEG image (4032x2688px per pdfimages -list) on each page, not as extractable text. Resolved by rendering each page to PNG at 200dpi via pdftoppm and reading the images directly. All room-rate and room-inventory figures below were read visually, not machine-extracted text — flagged prominently since this differs from most files in this batch (Diani Sea Resort/Lodge had the same issue for a different underlying reason).
tier: Single published rate card, with High/Festive season explicitly labeled 'Rack Rates' in its own table header — Low and Mid season tables carry no such label. Possible implication that Low/Mid are a form of negotiated/agent rate while only Festive is true Rack, but this is [Inference] — the sheet doesn't state it explicitly either way.

structuralFindings: TWO CURRENCIES, one per page: page 1 is the KES rate table, page 2 is the exact same table structure in USD — not two different rate tiers, but the same tier expressed in two currencies (values are not exact-rate-of-day FX conversions of each other by a simple ratio; e.g. KES Single/Garden Standard Low Season 14,500 vs USD 145.00 implies ~100 KES/USD, but Superior Room Low Season KES 35,000 vs USD 350.00 is consistent at the same ~100 ratio — so this does appear to be one simple assumed FX rate applied uniformly, not independently priced per currency; not explicitly confirmed by the source though).

Base meal plan for both currency tables is explicitly '(Bed, a la carte breakfast)' per the Low/Mid/High season sub-headers on page 2 (page 1's sub-headers for Low/Mid don't repeat the meal-plan text but the High/Festive header and the footer note both confirm Bed & Breakfast) — consistent across both pages.

Four room categories in the main rate grid: Standard Room (Garden facing), Standard Room (Sea facing), Classic Room (Sea facing), Superior Room (Sea facing) — Superior Room is priced as a single flat figure per occupancy tier (not split by view, since it's a single room type) spanning across the three lower-category columns visually (merged cell in the source table).

Separately, a 12-room bedding-options/inventory table lists every individual room number with its own bedding configuration, AC availability, capacity max, and view — this is NOT a pricing table, it's a room-inventory reference; room categories 6-11 share the 'Standard Sea Facing'/'Classic Room' names used in the price grid but the individual room numbers have different bed configurations and capacity (2-3 pax) within the same named category. Room #12 'Kijani Apartment' (3-bedroom self-serviced, 7 pax max) appears in the inventory table but has NO corresponding rate row in the main price grid at all — a genuine pricing gap for that specific unit.

Minor source inconsistency: the boilerplate line 'Rates are in Ksh per room per night inclusive of 16% VAT and 2% catering levy and 5% service charge' appears on BOTH pages, including the USD page — almost certainly a copy-paste carryover from the KES page rather than a real statement that the USD-page rates are secretly in KES. Recorded as printed but flagged as likely a source document error, not something to act on literally.
